issues.issue: Whether the appellant waived his complaint about interpretation by not raising it earlier
issues.applicant_position: Counsel raised the interpretation concern at the hearing, so the right to raise it was not waived.
issues.result_quote: I find that the Appellant has met his burden to raise the matter of the adequacy of interpretation at the earliest opportunity

issues.issue: Whether inadequate interpretation at the RPD hearing breached procedural fairness
issues.applicant_position: Interpretation errors made his evidence seem vague, so the RPD decision cannot stand.
issues.result_quote: the errors in interpretation at the RPD hearing in this case amounts to a breach in procedural fairness and the RPD decision therefore cannot stand

issues.issue: Whether the three letters dated after the RPD decision are admissible as new evidence under s. 110(4)
issues.applicant_position: The letters are new evidence and should be accepted under s. 110(4) of IRPA.
issues.result_quote: The new evidence (a), (b) and (c) submitted by the Appellant is therefore rejected.

issues.issue: Whether the interpreter's affidavit and partial audit are admissible as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: The affidavit is needed to show the RPD interpretation was inadequate.
issues.result_quote: I find that this document meets the requirements of subsection 110(4) of IRPA

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be held before the RAD
issues.applicant_position: Asked for an oral hearing before the RAD.
issues.result_quote: there is no provision for me to conduct an oral hearing in this matter and none will be conducted.
